panels.title: Executive Health
panels.description: High-level throughput, latency, errors, and queue pressure. Panels backed by optional exporters degrade to zero when those exporters are disabled.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(rulebricks_hps_rejections_total{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(rulebricks_hps_kafka_errors_total{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(rulebricks_app_http_rejections_total{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Ingress / Traefik
panels.description: Edge traffic when Traefik metrics are scraped.

panels.title: HPS Request Plane
panels.description: Synchronous API path, Kafka RPC latency, chunking, and rejections.

panels.title: Worker Fleet
panels.description: Worker throughput, processing latency, resources, and health.

panels.title: App + API Surface
panels.description: App/API traffic, app Redis activity, and Node.js runtime health.

panels.title: Cache / Valkey
panels.description: Service-level Redis usage from Rulebricks app/HPS/worker metrics, plus Valkey backend health when the Redis exporter is enabled.

panels.title: Kafka / Queue Health
panels.description: Consumer lag, topic storage, and broker pressure. Lag requires the Kafka exporter; broker panels require Kafka JMX metrics.

panels.title: Decision Logs / Logging Pipeline
panels.description: Decision-log production is emitted by HPS. Vector resource panels use Kubernetes container metrics; ClickHouse health panels require ClickHouse metrics scraping.

panels.title: Infrastructure
panels.description: Cloud-portable node, pod, PVC, and container metrics.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))
topk(20, sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", image!=""}))

(sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Scheduling / Pod Health
panels.description: Pod phase, restarts, and availability signals that work without event exporters.
